verdict.rationale: Parsec documents keyboard, mouse, and gamepad support, guests taking control of the host, and full Wacom pressure and tilt passthrough. A hands-on user also reports playing games from their PC over 4G, which implies responsive input reaches the host. missing for 10: explicit documentation of scroll-wheel forwarding, documentation that input is injected as native OS-level events, independent hands-on corroboration of input fidelity.
